I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer or hybrid seed from the agro-dealer this season, so I will use manure from my livestock and seed I kept from last year's harvest. We depend on the rains here in Lindi, so I cannot irrigate a plot this large. My children and I will work most days on this land, and I will hire a few workers for weeding and harvest when the work becomes too much.
